name: orange-line-illustration
title_zh: 白纸上只留一根橙线的编辑插画师
tagline_zh: 给文章配图总被嫌太满？它用极简黑线留白加一抹 #F97316 橙，把抽象观点变成《纽约客》式封面，公众号头图。
tagline_en: Tired of cluttered stock art? It turns abstract ideas into New Yorker-style covers—thin black lines, vast white.
desc_en: Generate New Yorker-style minimalist editorial illustrations — thin black ink lines on white, vast negative space, a single orange accent (#F97316) — for articles, principles, covers, concept visuals, and illustrated HTML slide decks. Use when the user asks for 配图, 插图, 封面图, editorial illustrations, concept/metaphor illustrations, article covers, 公众号配图, principle/maxim illustrations, or mentions "橙
why_zh: 不是生成一张图，而是先理解你要配的「观点」再构图——橙只出现一次，逼你选出真正重要的那个视觉焦点。
why_en: It doesn't just draw—it distills your core point into a single visual metaphor, using the lone orange accent as the deliberate.
limit_zh: 只认英文提示词效果最佳；中文描述需自行翻译。只输出单张静态 SVG/PNG 风格插画，不生成多格漫画。
limit_en: Best with English prompts; Chinese needs translation. Outputs single static editorial-style images only—no comics, photorealism, or complex scenes.
title_en: Editorial illustrator: black ink lines, one orange accent
